generations.prompt: Dusk outside a thatched riverside inn, golden hour, a small crowd of villagers holding cups. A medieval jongleur in a ragged red-and-white striped tunic and a battered feathered felt hat stands on a trestle table with his scruffy stray dog: he claps twice and the dog rises onto its hind legs and walks along the table beside him; he kicks up into a handstand and walks on his hands while the dog hops under his legs; he comes down, bows with a flourish of the hat, and the dog bows too, front legs stretched out; the villagers laugh and point without clapping. Camera level, nearly static. Photoreal, cinematic film look, 35mm, shallow depth of field, film grain. No text, no captions.
